description: This file is a PHP class definition for the ViewQuickcreate class, which extends the ViewAjax class within the Model-View-Controller framework of SuiteCRM/SugarCRM. It handles the rendering and processing of the quick create form in the CRM interface, including loading templates, handling pre-display logic, and integrating with other view classes. It manages display logic for adding new records quickly via AJAX.

classes.name: ViewQuickcreate
